title: Treatments
intro: Project treatments, each optional, set by presets. The original is never modified: each pass writes a copy "Name [codes].als" next to it, and a copy you edited in Live is never overwritten. Nothing changes the sound.

facts.P: Cleanup: {tracks} empty track(s), {devices} disabled device(s), {returns} return(s) removed

R.text: Plugins reconnected or replaced, found samples copied into the project: same as the Repair page.

C.clips: Clips too, one shade per different clip

O.makeGroupsTitle: Neutral groups (0 dB, centre, no sends or effects): the sound doesn't change. Only tracks routed straight to the master that nothing listens to, if the project already contains a group to use as a model

P.emptyTracksTitle: No clip or device, and nothing listens to them
P.disabledDevicesTitle: Off, with no automation turning them back on
P.unusedReturnsTitle: No track sends any sound to them
P.simplifyGroupsTitle: The same EQ (same settings) at the end of every track in a group moves once onto the group. Only effects that sound exactly the same on the sum
P.text: Each rule checks the routing (sidechains, tracks listening to others, sends, automation) and leaves things alone at the slightest doubt. A compressor or saturation is never moved.

M.onlyIfNone: Only if the project has none
M.sections: Sections of at least {input} bars. Same combination of tracks = same letter (A, B, A...).

redone: Redone from the original: the existing copy had not been edited.
approxColors: Approximate colours: the real ones are those of Live's palette.
